log: Working out who would actually buy this
Rechecking product fit for the same audiences; market evidence is retained

Search results were rich in vendor pages, affiliate-funded reviews and self-selected review platforms but thin in indexed Reddit discussions and independently documented agency deployments. No current paid-plan prices were accepted because the supplied product material explicitly reported none. Evidence remains missing for deliverability, dedicated IPs, uptime or SLA, exit exports, advanced tax and fulfilment, enterprise LMS standards, granular agency permissions, native live coaching, and comparative feature depth. The physical-product fit should remain limited to small catalogues until independently tested. Trustpilot and software-directory reviews demonstrate reported behavior, not representative prevalence.
7 audience(s) mapped; 0 worth exploring first. Commercial priority is a hypothesis, not a response-rate forecast.
